title: Efficient Block-Layer Parallel Inference for Vision-Language-Action on Hybrid Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2608.14586v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are becoming a promising paradigm for autonomous driving, but their deployment on existing vehicle platforms remains difficult because they introduce both high inference latency and strong GPU-side resource pressure. In a full autonomous driving stack, this problem is even more pronounced: legacy vehicle platforms were provisioned for modular pipelines, yet after several planning-related functions are absorbed into a unified VLA model, part of the original CPU budget becomes underutilized, while the visual encoder and the main reasoning path still concentrate most computation and memory demand on the GPU. As a result, directly deploying VLA together with the rest of the onboard system can be hard under realistic GPU memory constraints. translated_title: 面向混合架构的高效块级并行推理用于视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型正成为自动驾驶的一种有前景的范式，但它们在现有车辆平台上的部署仍然困难，因为它们引入了高推理延迟和强大的GPU端资源压力。在完整的自动驾驶栈中，这个问题更加突出：传统车辆平台是为模块化流水线设计的，然而在若干规划相关功能被整合到统一的VLA模型后，部分原始CPU预算变得利用不足，而视觉编码器和主要推理路径仍将大部分计算和内存需求集中在GPU上。因此，在现实GPU内存约束下，直接部署VLA与车载系统的其余部分可能很困难。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种混合CPU-GPU推理框架，具有灵活的资源配置用于自动驾驶。我们的设计将VLA主干网络进行划分。
tldr: 本文提出了一种混合CPU-GPU推理框架，通过灵活调度资源和划分VLA主干网络，解决了自动驾驶中VLA模型部署时GPU资源压力大和推理延迟高的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid CPU-GPU inference framework that partitions the VLA backbone and flexibly schedules resources, addressing high GPU memory pressure and inference latency in deploying VLA models for autonomous driving.
